seoTitle: CSV Column Merger: Join Columns with a Separator
metaDescription: Concatenate several CSV columns into one new column with your separator, skipping empty parts. Free, in your browser.
intro: Adds a column built from several others, such as street, postcode and city joined into an address.
why:
The reverse of text to columns. List the columns in order, choose the separator and name the new column. Empty values are skipped so you do not get double commas.

You can keep the original columns or drop them. The new column is added at the end. Useful for building labels, full names, search keys and mailing lines.
howTo: Paste the CSV with a header.
List the columns to join, in order.
Set the separator and the new column name.

faq.q: Where does the new column go?
Can I join with a new line?
faq.a: Not through the separator field; use a visible separator and replace afterwards.
